title: Render the counter component
objective: Build a small semantic component before adding behavior.
tasks: Replace the placeholder paragraph with a short instruction about counting pallets.
Add a section labelled Pallet counter and render count inside an output element.
Give the output aria-live="polite"; confirm the preview shows Pallets: 0.
hints: Use className for CSS classes and braces to render a JavaScript value.
Keep the existing default App export and stylesheet import.

title: Remember the pallet count
objective: Use local React state to update the rendered count.
tasks: Import useState and replace the fixed count with useState(0).
Add an Add pallet button whose click handler increments with a functional state updater.
Click three times and confirm the displayed count becomes 3 without reloading.
hints: useState returns the current value and its setter.
Pass a function to onClick; call the setter inside it rather than during render.

title: Bound subtraction and reset
objective: Keep a nonnegative counter through every available action.
tasks: Add Remove pallet with a functional updater clamped to zero.
Disable Remove pallet at zero and add Reset that sets count to zero.
Check Add three times → Remove → Reset; repeat Remove at zero and verify the count stays zero.
hints: Math.max(0, current - 1) protects the update itself.
Reset sets the one source of truth; the output and disabled state derive from it.
